versioning_rule.architectural_revision: v2.0 — only when a genuine architectural defect requires deliberate versioning
versioning_rule.do_not_report_as: simply '100%' as if the finish line were still moving

hard_rule: Nothing may reopen the foundational architecture merely because we discover something interesting. A future discovery can confirm, weaken, modify, or invalidate a proposition. If it exposes a genuine architectural defect, we version the system deliberately. Otherwise it goes into the appropriate existing structure.

completion_closed.note: Completion is no longer measured by adding architecture. The architecture is closed.

stewardship_lanes.label: Evidence Updates
stewardship_lanes.purpose: Better data, new budgets, pilot results, court decisions, economic changes. Update confidence or conclusions without reopening the system.

stewardship_lanes.label: Public Understanding
stewardship_lanes.purpose: Deepen Comparison Explorer, World Laboratory, historical examples, interactive teaching, charts, maps — make the certified system understandable at extraordinary depth.

stewardship_lanes.label: Version Improvements
stewardship_lanes.purpose: Editorial refinement, improved visuals, corrected sources, accessibility, UX, updated examples, future editions of the Public Book.

stewardship_lanes.label: Implementation / Pilots
stewardship_lanes.purpose: Only when deliberately chosen. Arkansas application projects governed by certified tests — not extensions of the foundational build.

build_future.label: BUILD
build_future.note: Not claimed as existing foundational work.
